courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
related.transfer: 可遷移「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」與「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高強度混凝土高程泵送的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness" and "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦扶壁核心、Y 形平面與螺旋退縮，加上高性能混凝土、超高泵送與長期監測，如何撐起 828 m 的高塔；高強度混凝土高程泵送則以把黏稠的高強度混凝土推上數百公尺：靜壓、管壁摩擦、輸送管強度、可泵性與連續供料為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how a buttressed core, Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks, with high-performance concrete, extreme pumping and monitoring, carry an 828 m tower; High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete centres on pushing viscous high-strength concrete hundreds of metres up: static head, wall friction, pipeline strength, pumpability and continuous supply, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「Y 形扶壁核心」與「泵送壓力需求」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高強度混凝土高程泵送，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Y-shaped buttressed core” and “Pump pressure demand”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 哈里發塔
history.text: 哈里發塔（原名杜拜塔）由 Emaar Properties 開發，SOM 負責建築與結構設計（William F. Baker 主導結構），Hyder Consulting 為當地紀錄建築師與工程師，三星物產領銜承攬；2004 年開挖、2009 年封頂、2010 年 1 月啟用，以 828 m 成為世界最高建築。它的扶壁核心延續以混凝土牆為主的高層系統，搭配 Y 形平面與螺旋退縮降低風力，並把高性能混凝土泵送、GPS 測量與長期監測推到新的高度。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Burj Khalifa, originally Burj Dubai, was developed by Emaar Properties and designed architecturally and structurally by SOM, with William F. Baker leading the structure, Hyder Consulting as local architect and engineer of record and Samsung C&T leading construction; excavation began in 2004, it topped out in 2009 and opened in January 2010 as the world's tallest building at 828 m. Its buttressed core extends concrete wall-based tall-building systems, combined with a Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks to reduce wind loads, and it pushed high-performance concrete pumping, GPS surveying and long-term monitoring to new heights. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
